description: This file defines a class `AppTheme` with a static method `oceanProfessional` which builds and returns a `ThemeData` object configured with specific color schemes and UI element styles for a Flutter app's theme.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing a predefined theme for the Flutter app with a specific color scheme and styling.

methods.name: oceanProfessional
methods.description: Constructs and returns a `ThemeData` object styled with blue primary, amber secondary, rounded corners, and other UI customizations for a professional ocean-inspired theme.
